info.title: WORKFLOW-JneDev-List Customers Api Orders-v1-spec
info.description: The Customer Orders Retrieval API allows businesses to access a comprehensive list of customer orders associated with their accounts. This endpoint facilitates the retrieval of order details, which can include statuses, product information, and timestamps. Typical consumers of this API are customer support teams, sales representatives, and inventory management systems looking to enhance customer service and streamline order processing. With this API, organizations can effectively monitor and manage customer orders, improving overall operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific order. You can obtain information such as order status, items included, and customer information. Ensure to provide the required query parameters for accurate results.
